name: Thermi Smooth

lead: ThermiSmooth is a non-invasive radiofrequency device from Thermi that warms the skin with automatic temperature feedback to stimulate collagen remodeling. It is used to tighten loose skin without surgery.
A published 40-person study used it on upper-eyelid and infrabrow laxity with protective shields.

paras: A clinician moves a handpiece over the area in circular motions while the device monitors temperature; for eyelids, opaque shields protect the eye.
The eye is sensitive to RF energy, so protective shields are used in periorbital treatment; treatment is performed by trained providers.

studies.title: A Proposed Method for Upper Eyelid and Infrabrow Tightening Using a Transcutaneous Temperature Controlled Radiofrequency Device With Opaque Plastic Eye Shields.
studies.source: Journal of drugs in dermatology : JDD

chain: RF heats the skin under temperature control
angle.text: Clinicians use it as a non-surgical option for eyelid and infrabrow laxity.

lead: ThermiSmooth is a transcutaneous temperature-controlled radiofrequency (TTCRF) device that delivers superficial RF energy with automatic temperature feedback, intended to stimulate collagen remodeling for skin tightening.[1]
In a published study of 40 subjects aged 33 to 72 with mild to moderate eyelid and infrabrow laxity, the device was used with opaque black plastic eye shields to protect the eye.[1]

paras: Temperature feedback control regulates energy deposition during treatment.[1]
A 2016 study treated 40 subjects with a 10 mm monopolar emitter plus eye shields to propose a method for tightening the eyelid and infrabrow.[1]
